restaurants.name: Windy City Pie
restaurants.signature: The caramelized cheese crown — a molten parmesan ring fused to the pan wall
restaurants.blurb: Started as a clandestine SoDo parking-lot handoff: call ahead, text on arrival, trade cash for a deep pan pie. Now a proper Phinney Ridge dining room where your pizza is walked to the table like a bottle of Barolo. The bake is engineered — a buttery biscuit-crumb base, a tomato layer with real acid, and a cheese wall that shatters. It also bakes the sourdough-base Breezy Town pie, Tuesday to Thursday in limited numbers, since that sibling's Beacon Hill room closed.

craft.note: The Infatuation rates this Phinney Ridge Chicago deep-dish spot 8.6/10 and says it's worth crossing town for, praising the puffy, deep crust with a near-burnt caramelized-cheese edge and naming the sausage-pepperoni-bacon 'Meatza' a standout; KOMO's Seattle Refined profiles owner Dave Lichterman's house-made dough and generous toppings, including his own favorite, the pineapple-and-giardiniera 'Sweet Pete.'
